FBI
Lombroso
Eysenck

Eysenck
Bandura
Lombroso

mcqs.q: What is the difference between top-down and bottom-up offender profiling?
options: They are two names for the same profiling method.
Atavistic form refers to a type of prison sentence.
Top-down profiling is done by senior officers and bottom-up by junior ones.
Top-down fits offenders to pre-set categories (organised/disorganised); bottom-up builds a profile from statistical analysis of the evidence.

mcqs.q: Did Lombroso's 'atavistic form' theory have strong scientific support?
options: Atavistic form refers to a type of prison sentence.
It is a well-supported, accurate explanation of crime.
Custodial sentencing means a fine paid to the court.
No; the idea that criminals show primitive physical features is now discredited and lacked proper controls.

mcqs.q: Does custodial sentencing reliably reduce reoffending?
options: Prison always successfully stops people reoffending.
Custodial sentencing means a fine paid to the court.
Not reliably; recidivism rates are often high and prison can have negative as well as deterrent effects.
Top-down profiling is done by senior officers and bottom-up by junior ones.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Eysenck's theory”?
options: Sutherland (1939): criminal behaviour learned from associates whose pro-crime attitudes outweigh anti-crime ones.
Criminals score high on extraversion, neuroticism and psychoticism (E, N, P); inherited nervous system underactivity.
Canter's UK approach: statistical analysis of crime scene data to derive profiles; investigative psychology.
Imprisonment aims to deter, rehabilitate, incapacitate and protect; UK recidivism around 48% within one year.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Atavistic form”?
options: Canter's UK approach: statistical analysis of crime scene data to derive profiles; investigative psychology.
Sutherland (1939): criminal behaviour learned from associates whose pro-crime attitudes outweigh anti-crime ones.
Lombroso's (1876) outdated theory that criminals are evolutionary throwbacks identifiable by physical features.
Imprisonment aims to deter, rehabilitate, incapacitate and protect; UK recidivism around 48% within one year.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Custodial sentencing”?
options: Lombroso's (1876) outdated theory that criminals are evolutionary throwbacks identifiable by physical features.
Imprisonment aims to deter, rehabilitate, incapacitate and protect; UK recidivism around 48% within one year.
Canter's UK approach: statistical analysis of crime scene data to derive profiles; investigative psychology.
FBI approach (Ressler 1986): classify crime scene as organised or disorganised to infer offender characteristics.
